title: GitHub Copilot CLI Plugin Manifest
description: Plugin manifest accepted by GitHub Copilot CLI, looked up as .plugin/plugin.json, plugin.json, .github/plugin/plugin.json, then .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Authored from the official CLI plugin reference; GitHub publishes no JSON Schema for this manifest.
$comment: Provenance: authored (not upstream-vendored) 2026-09-08. Source: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-cli-reference/cli-plugin-reference (raw markdown in github/docs). Declaring the canonical agent-plugins.org $schema opts the plugin into Agent Plugins v1.0.0 additively; the extensions field then changes meaning. Unknown properties are reported and ignored.

$schema.description: Set to the agent-plugins.org v1.0.0 plugin schema URL to opt into Open Plugin Spec semantics.

name.description: Kebab-case plugin name (letters, numbers, hyphens). Plugins opting into Open Plugin Spec support may also use dots, for example acme.tools.

agents.description: Path(s) to agent directories containing .agent.md files. Default agents/.

skills.description: Path(s) to skill directories containing SKILL.md. Default skills/.

hooks.description: Path to a hooks configuration file, or an inline hooks object.

extensions.description: Path(s) to extension directories, or { paths: [...], exclusive: true } to suppress built-in extensions. In Open Plugin Spec mode the field has a different meaning.

mcpServers.description: Path to an MCP configuration file such as .mcp.json, or inline server definitions.

lspServers.description: Path to an LSP configuration file, or inline server definitions.

lspServer.description: One language server. At least one of command, bash, or powershell is required. When both bash and powershell are given, the platform-appropriate one is selected automatically.

bash.description: Bash script for Linux/macOS, executed via bash -c SCRIPT.

powershell.description: PowerShell script for Windows, executed via pwsh -c SCRIPT.

cwd.description: Working directory; absolute or relative to the configuration file. Supports ${PLUGIN_ROOT}.

args.description: Arguments for command; ignored for bash and powershell.

fileExtensions.description: Map of file extension to language id, for example { ".ts": "typescript" }.

rootUri.description: Project root relative to the git root; default ".".

initializationOptions.description: Options sent in the LSP initialize request.
